pn: Puṇḍarīka 01. One of the state elephants of Pasenadi. Dhp-a.ii.1.
Puṇḍarīka 02. A Niraya; it is a period of suffering in Avīci, equal to twenty Uppalakā. SN.i.152; Snp., p.126; Snp-a.ii.476.
Puṇḍarīka 03. One of the four treasure troves left behind by the Buddha when he renounced the world. DN-a.i.284.

S: puṇḍarīka：n．[〃] 白蓮，蓮華，分陀利迦．-niraya 白蓮地獄．
P: Puṇḍarīka，（nt．） [Non-Aryan （?）．Cp．Vedic puṇḍarīka] the white lotus D．I，75=A．III，26 （in sequence uppala，padụma，p．）； D．II，4 （Sikhī puṇḍarīkassa mūle abhisambuddho）； M．III，93； S．I，138，204=J．III，309； A．I，145 （uppala paduma p．）； II，86 sq．（samaṇa° adj．）； Sn．547； J．V，45，215 （°ttac’aṅgī=ratta-paduma-patta-vaṇṇasarīrā）； Vv 4412 （=seta-kamala VvA．191）； Pv．II，122； III，33 （pokkharaṇī bahu °ā）； Pug．63； DA．I，219，284 （saṅkho elo uppalo puṇḍarīko ti cattāro nidhayo）．N．of a hell S．I，152； Sn．p．126 （here in sq．Uppalaka，Puṇḍ°，Paduma）．（Page 465）
R:
puṇḍarīka：ပုဏ္ဍရီက （န）
ကြာတံဆိပ်။ ကြာဖြူ။ သုညရေ ၁၁၂ ရှိသော သချၤာသဒ္ဒါ။
V:
Pundarīka：1．Pundarīka．One of the state elephants ofPasenadi．DhA．ii．1．

2．Pundarīka．A Niraya； it is a period of suffering inAvīci，equal to twenty Uppalakā．S．i．152； SN．，p．126； SNA．ii．476．

3．Pundarīka．One of the four treasure troves left behind by the Buddha when he renounced the world．DA．i．284．

Pundarīka Sutta．A monk，staying in a forest tract in Kosala，once entered a lotus pool and inhaled the scent of a lotus．The deva of the forest，desirous of his welfare，called him ”scent thief ” and engaged him in conversation，whereby he was greatly agitated．S．i．204f．
Pundarīkā：A class of nymphs who provided music for Sakka，or， perhaps，the name of some musical instruments．See VvA．93，96，211； and 372f．
DOP: puṇḍarīka n.m. [ ts ], 1. ( n. ) (the flower of) a lotus (usually white, but sometimes said to be red); Abh 476; 686 (~aṃ sitaṃ); Vin III 49, 6 (tatthajātakaṃ uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā ~aṃ vā … theyyacitto āmasati, āpatti dukkaṭassa); S I 204, 33* (yvāyaṃ bhisāni khaṇati ~āni bhañjati, Be, Ce, Ee bhuñjati) = Ja III 309, 3* ; A I 145, 8 (ekattha sudaṃ uppalaṃ pupphati ekattha padumaṃ ekattha ~aṃ yāva-d-eva mama atthāya, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se vappati; Mp II 236, 7 : paduman ti paṇḍarapadumaṃ, ~an ti rattapadumaṃ); III 347, 6* (yathā pi udake jātaṃ ~aṃ pavaḍḍhati na upalippati toyena sucigandhaṃ manoramaṃ) = Th 700; Sn 547; Ja VI 518, 20* (saro ~ehi sañchanno); Ap 238, 3 (~aṃ mayā dinnaṃ); 363, 3 (padumā pupphare tattha ~ā ca uppalā); Sv 219, 3 foll. (ūnakasatapattaṃ ~aṃ satapattaṃ padumaṃ … setaṃ padumaṃ rattaṃ ~an ti); Ap-a 452, 4 (°-samotthaṭo ti ~ehi rattapadumehi okiṇṇo); — 2. ( i ) ( n. ) a high numeral; a great number (of years); Abh 476 (kumudaṃ ~aṃ ca padumaṃ …); Sadd 802, 20* (ababaṃ aṭaṭaṃ … ~aṃ ca paduman ti); — ( ii ) ( m [ fn ].) the name of a hell or place in Avīci (where one suffers for a puṇḍarīka of years); S I 152, 15 (seyyathā pi bhikkhu vīsati uppalakā nirayā evam eko ~o nirayo) = A V 173, 19 = Sn p. 126, 22 ; — 3. ( m. ) a tree; SAF: White mango, Mangifera zeylanica Hook., or Mangifera Indica L.; Abh 558 (~o ca setambo); D II 4, 8 (Sikhī … bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho ~assa mūle abhisambuddho); Ap 160, 28 (°-phalāni); 199, 5 (nisinnaṃ ~amhi chāyā na jahi taṃ muniṃ); 328, 26 (phārusakā alābū ca ~ā ca pupphitā); Bv 21:21 (bodhi tassa bhagavato ~o ti vuccati; Bv-a 247, 1 : ~o ti setambarukkho, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee °-rukkho ti); — 4. ( m. ) one of the four treasures or treasure-jars of a bodhisatta; Sv 284, 7 foll. (tathāgatassa pana jātadivase yeva saṅkho elo uppalo ~o ti cattāro nidhayo upagatā … ~o yojaniko ti) = Ps III 420, 12 foll.; — 5. ( m. ) a tiger; Abh 611 (vyaggho tu ~o).

puṇḍarīkinī.p: [ puṇḍarīka + inī ] (thī) CL=10 A pond-forest-river with puṇḍarīka lotus flowers.

S: puṇḍarīkinī：f．[puṇḍarīka-in の f．] 白蓮池，蓮池，白蓮を有する池．
P: Puṇḍarīkinī，（f．） [adj．pundarīkin，of puṇḍarīka] a pool or pond of white lotuses D．I，75≈（M．III，93； S．I，138）．（Page 465）
